en: The image depicts a dramatic, lifelike sculpture of a mounted knight, possibly a saint, on a white horse. The knight, dressed in elaborate period armor, is wielding a sword and trampling several figures beneath the horse, some wearing turbans and armor. The background is a solid, dark red. In the top left corner is a coat of arms with the text 'Sede de Compostela.' In the bottom left, the text 'Biblioteca de Galicia' is visible.
